html:
Behind the scenes this week, we focused on making requests actually stick.

  • Fixed a snag where certain shows and seasons appeared unavailable and couldn't be re-requested — that's sorted now.
  • Added a way to flag your favorite ongoing shows as protected, so new episodes keep arriving automatically instead of needing a fresh request each time.
  • Closed a rare glitch where a newly requested title could vanish again almost immediately.

Plus a few quieter reliability tune-ups behind the curtain. 🎬
